content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DERC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the DERC website and access the notice for vacancy. Click on the online application link to open the Online Application Form. Fill in all mandatory fields in the form without leaving any column blank. Upload relevant documents to substantiate essential qualifications along with the last 3 months' salary slips, ITR Statements, and Form-16. Submit the application online and complete the submission process.

faq.question: Q1. What is DERC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: DERC Recruitment 2026 is an employment notification issued by the Delhi Electricity Regulatory Commission to fill 16 vacancies across finance, law, and support functions on a deputation or contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under DERC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 16 vacancies available across various posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for DERC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of online application is 10 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification for Advisor (Finance)?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBA in Finance OR Chartered Accountant or Certified Cost Accountant preferably with Engineering Degree from a premier, reputed & recognized institution/university, along with requisite regular service.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for contract employees?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for contract employees shall not exceed 54 years on the last date of submission of application.
